purpose: Interdental brush buff; diagnostic first-five-wave runs, not human win rates or a full-run balance verdict.

earned_before.method: One free starter, finite HP and persistent earned XP/gold/gear through waves 1-5. Real Hell/Normal stats, timed waves, loot sweep, offered level choices, earned fire upgrades, actual seeded shop offers, matching weapons plus at most one staple item and four paid rerolls per shop. No free HP/coins/items, no mastery, no dash or warning reactions. Orbit or range-aware pursuit of nearest enemy; boss pursuit at shortest weapon reach. Diagnostic policies, not human winrates.

pilots_before.method: Rule-based, delayed common-viewport observations; diagnostic, not human winrates. Independent movement and build policies, actual movement/dash and earned progression. Probes ending by W5 retain the historical early boss-kill stop. Longer runs follow complete timed boss waves, loot, offered relics and shops through W20. One free starter; all subsequent gear and ranks are earned. No future spawns or hidden attack planning.
